items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: We played there for Mr. I think Mr. Albert... We played 101 Ranch a long time.

ctx.x: We played there for Mr. I think Mr. Albert, what was his name now? We played 101 Ranch a long time. We used to start playing at eight. Playing until wee in the morning when he'd break up. We only got a dollar and a half a night for playing there but we made the tips was good, you see. Oh yeah. That was a rough place but we made good tips in there.
Who was in the band at that time?
